<module id="fsm">
    <description>Detection circuit for the sequence '10011' using a Mealy FSM.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="IN" width_description="">Single-bit input signal.</input>
        <input id="CLK">Clock signal for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="RST">Active-high reset signal.</input>
        <output id="MATCH">Output signal indicating a match condition.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="IDLE">State where the FSM waits for the start of the sequence.</parameter>
        <parameter id="S1">State after detecting the first '1'.</parameter>
        <parameter id="S2">State after detecting '00' following '1'.</parameter>
        <parameter id="S3">State after detecting '11' following '00'.</parameter>
        <parameter id="SEQ_MATCH">Constant representing the matched sequence '10011'.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <register id="current_state" width="2">Current state of the FSM.</register>
        <wire id="next_state">Next state of the FSM.</wire>
        <wire id="match_flag">Flag to indicate a match condition.</wire>
        <always @(*)>
            // Determine next state based on current state and input
            case(current_state)
                IDLE: begin
                    if (IN == 1'b1) next_state = S1;
                    else next_state = IDLE;
                end
                S1: begin
                    if (IN == 1'b0) next_state = S2;
                    else next_state = IDLE;
                end
                S2: begin
                    if (IN == 1'b0) next_state = S2;
                    else if (IN == 1'b1) next_state = S3;
                    else next_state = IDLE;
                end
                S3: begin
                    if (IN == 1'b1) next_state = S1;
                    else next_state = IDLE;
                end
                default: next_state = IDLE;
            endcase

            // Set match_flag based on current state and input
            if (current_state == S3 && IN == 1'b1) match_flag = 1'b1;
            else match_flag = 1'b0;

            // Update current state on positive edge of CLK or RST
            if (RST == 1'b1 || CLK'event && CLK == 1'b1) current_state <= next_state;
        end
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>FSM transitions based on input sequence detection. Match flag set at specific conditions.</implementation>
</module>
